meta_title: Shadez A Green Gardening | Garden Services Birmingham
meta_description: Shadez A Green Gardening Services in Birmingham. Expert garden maintenance, landscaping, and design. Call 07734 221158 for a free quote today.
hero_eyebrow: Local Birmingham Gardener — Garden Design & Maintenance
hero_subhead: From overgrown borders to show-stopping outdoor spaces—we handle everything so you can enjoy your garden.
services_subhead: Whether you need weekly maintenance, a complete redesign, or seasonal clearance, we've got your garden covered.

services.title: Garden Maintenance & Care
services.desc: Regular grass cutting, hedge trimming, weeding, and seasonal bed maintenance keep your garden looking its best year-round. We work to your schedule—weekly, fortnightly, or monthly visits.

services.title: Garden Design & Landscaping
services.desc: From concept to completion, we design and build gardens that fit your lifestyle and budget. Hard landscaping, planting schemes, pathways, and outdoor living spaces all handled in-house.

services.title: Overgrown Garden Clearance
services.desc: Reclaim that jungle you've been avoiding. We clear dense vegetation, fallen branches, and rubbish safely and responsibly, then leave your space clean and ready for the next phase.

services.title: Tree Surgery & Pruning
services.desc: Safe, professional felling, pruning, and crown thinning for trees of all sizes. We handle diseased, dangerous, or simply overgrown specimens with precision and care.

services.title: Lawn Seeding & Repair
services.desc: Tired of patchy grass? We scarify, seed, and feed lawns back to health, or lay fresh turf for an instant green space ready for immediate use.

services.title: Paving, Decking & Hard Landscaping
services.desc: Durable patios, decking platforms, retaining walls, and gravel beds built to last. Every project finished to a professional standard with attention to drainage and safety.

about_pullquote: A garden should make you want to step outside. That's what we build.
about_para_1: Shadez A Green started as a one-man operation over a decade ago, born from a passion for transforming tired outdoor spaces into places people genuinely enjoy. We've grown steadily across Birmingham, building a reputation for honest, reliable work and fair pricing. Every project—whether a monthly tidy or a full landscape redesign—is treated with the same care and attention to detail.
about_para_2: Our customers come back because we listen, we're punctual, and we don't overcomplicate things. We've worked on everything from small urban backyards to substantial country gardens, and we pride ourselves on leaving every space cleaner and better than we found it. Birmingham locals know us for showing up when we say we will, giving straight answers, and pricing that doesn't shock.
reviews_heading: What Birmingham Homeowners Say About Us

reviews.text: We had about two tonnes of brambles, ivy, and dead wood taking over the back garden. Shadez came round, gave us a fair quote, and cleared the lot in a morning. Left everything tidy and even tidied up our patio while they were at it. Can't recommend them highly enough.
reviews.author: James P.

reviews.text: Been using them for the weekly maintenance for over a year now. Never missed a slot, always on time, always friendly. My garden looks better than it ever has. Worth every penny.
reviews.author: Margaret T.

reviews.text: Landscaped our whole back garden from scratch. What was just overgrown grass is now a lovely patio and planting beds. The lads worked hard, cleared up after themselves, and the finish is really professional. Very pleased.
reviews.author: David R.
